name: ascii-renderer
title: ASCII Renderer
description: OGL WebGL image rendered as animated ASCII dot-grid characters with scanline displacement.

usage.label: Astro
usage.code:
---
import "@/components/motion-kit/ascii-renderer-element.ts";
---

<motion-ascii-renderer
  image="/images/your-image.jpg"
  density={25.0}
  strength={3.0}
  color="#6c87bc"
  background-color="#17181A"
  class="w-full h-[400px]"
/>

usage.label: React
Vue

<script setup>
import "@/components/motion-kit/ascii-renderer-element.ts";
</script>

<template>
  <motion-ascii-renderer
    image="/images/your-image.jpg"

    :strength="3.0"
    color="#6c87bc"

    class="w-full h-[400px]"
  />
</template>

usage.label: HTML
usage.code:
<script type="module" src="/components/motion-kit/ascii-renderer-element.js"></script>

<motion-ascii-renderer
  image="/images/your-image.jpg"
  density="25.0"
  strength="3.0"
  color="#6c87bc"
  background-color="#17181A"
  class="w-full h-[400px]"
/>

props.name: image
props.description: URL of the image to render as ASCII.

props.name: density
props.description: Density of the ASCII character grid (higher = more characters).

props.name: strength
props.description: Intensity of the ASCII character brightness based on image luminance.

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the ASCII characters (any CSS color value).

props.name: background-color
props.description: Background color behind the ASCII characters (any CSS color value).
